name: CISA KEV Tagging
summary: Laelaps — CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities on your assets, joined to CISA's catalog: remediation due dates (overdue / due soon), ransomware use, crown jewels and vendors. Tags assets CISA KEV:Vulnerable (xref), by catalog date added, by CISA due date (CISA KEV Due:<YYYY-MM-DD>) and CISA KEV:Ransomware. Plus an NL→SQL to hunt KEV in navi.db / tags.
